about_short_description.short_description: Tawal design, build and manage integrated ICT infrastructure that enables clients to minimize expenses and achieve efficiency.

product.name: Built-to-Suit
product.description: End-to-end design and construction of telecom towers tailored to client specifications, including site acquisition, tower, shelter, and power supply.

product.name: Colocation
product.description: Leasing space on existing telecom towers to multiple operators or enterprises for shared use of passive infrastructure.

product.name: In-Building Solutions (IBS)
product.description: Design, implementation, and operation of internal telecom coverage systems to enhance network quality inside buildings and crowded areas.

product.name: Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Services
product.description: Maintenance and operation of passive telecom infrastructure including towers, shelters, and power supply, following safety and quality standards.

product.name: TAWALi Customers Platform
product.description: A digital platform providing customers with tools for digital purchasing, network location selection, 24/7 support, and operational management.

product.name: TAWALi SHURAKAA Platform
product.description: A digital platform facilitating rapid and efficient leasing procedures for TAWAL’s real estate assets.
